title: What Kosovo’s prime minister asked the EU to do in Brussels
description: Albin Kurti asked EU leaders to grant Kosovo candidate status and urged closer cooperation among the six Western Balkan partners.
paragraphs: Speaking at the opening of the EU–Western Balkans summit in Brussels on 25 November 2026, Kosovo’s prime minister, Albin Kurti, called for EU candidate status and for the European Commission to assess Kosovo’s application. He said Kosovo had applied nearly four years earlier.

Kurti framed candidacy as recognition of progress in democratic governance, the economy and the rule of law. He also called for faster regional cooperation and mobility agreements. The statement sets out Kosovo’s position at the start of the summit.

title: How six sampled comments responded to a video on Polish defence spending
description: The Monitor classified six comments on a Polish video about the cost of defence spending. Three opposed the video’s message, two supported it and one was unrelated.
paragraphs: On 21 November 2026, the Polish YouTube channel Nasi – Damian Piecha published a video asking whether Poland could afford a large increase in military spending. The Monitor’s retained transcript summary identifies affordability and the cost of sustaining the increase as the video’s main concern.

In the 2026-W47 sample, three of six classified comments opposed the video’s message, two supported it and one was unrelated. These provisional classifications describe how the six sampled comments responded to this video. The result applies to this sample and thread.
